clothes.en: Mum keeps my clothes neatly folded in the drawer.
clothes.cn: 妈妈把我的衣服整齐地叠在抽屉里。

shirt.en: I always wear a clean shirt to school.

T-shirt.cn: 我 T 恤是蓝色的。

T-shirt.en: I wear a cotton T-shirt on hot summer days.
T-shirt.cn: 炎热夏日我穿棉 T 恤。

skirt.en: Lily wears a long flower skirt to the party.
skirt.cn: 莉莉穿着长花裙去聚会。

trousers.en: These blue trousers feel very comfortable.
trousers.cn: 这条蓝裤子穿着很舒服。

shoes.en: Sports shoes are great for running on the playground.
shoes.cn: 运动鞋很适合在操场上跑步。

hat.en: Don't forget your hat — the sun is very strong today.
hat.cn: 别忘戴帽子——今天太阳很大。

wear.en: What will you wear to the school party tonight?
wear.cn: 今晚学校聚会你穿什么？
